title: Barcode Intake Card
user: A micro-seller or workshop receiving miscellaneous stock who needs to turn a barcode scan into a reviewable item card without sending supplier or inventory data to a third party.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA scanner with manual/CSV lookup, photo and supplier fields, duplicate-candidate review, and printable one-up label/card export.
success_measure: A pilot can record 30 miscellaneous items in under an hour with at least 90% having a searchable barcode and location note.
catalog_description: Turn a barcode scan into a private, printable item card.
